reason: Yes for the narrow definitional fix, not for the discredited 99% headline. Both red-teams are integrated verbatim and all O1-O5/B1-B6 are answered. The Act expressly amends Act 21 §§1-3 and §5 to distinguish the verified candidate from a status-only direct-child carrier integrated in one fast-forward, preserves exact candidate-tree verification for every substantive change, requires ten hermetic cases, and states that Git records prove consistency, not execution. O5/B5 remain genuinely unresolved cost/benefit questions and the Clerk's evidence shows the 99% figure is a checker/Act-26 gap, not this self-reference; I accept that a yes does not restore the compliance rate. No Act 22 predictions are registered because the bill is outside the pilot; I do not claim calibration evidence. The Act does not weaken Act 21 for non-carrier changes or alter Judiciary independence.
